about: A first question for every Ask Sakhi chat guide, in English, Hindi and Hinglish, as women type them (Version 40.5.1, 10 Nov 2026): drafted by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from each guide's title and summary, checked by hand. server/scripts/chat-scenarios.mjs asks each one on its own.
